content: lalalune: Drove extensive improvements to the elizaos/eliza codebase by merging 108 pull requests focused on stabilizing CI/CD pipelines, refining mobile UI gestures, and optimizing chat performance through streaming-aware parsing and embedding enhancements. Their work significantly improved system reliability and user experience, with major contributions including the implementation of the liquid-glass UI system (#15240), mobile native-webview isolation (#15349), and comprehensive bugfixes across the OS-Linux and CI infrastructure.
